name: Wide Establishing
description: A wide, cinematic establishing shot where the subject sits small against a dramatic real environment — scale and atmosphere over close detail, the opening frame of a campaign film rather than a packshot.
subject: either
prompt: a wide cinematic establishing shot with the subject positioned small within the frame against a dramatic, real outdoor or architectural environment — a wide plaza, an open coastline, a mountain trailhead — genuine environmental atmosphere doing most of the visual work: true weather, natural light behavior, and authentic scale relationships between the subject and its surroundings, deep focus holding both the subject and the environment credibly sharp, a restrained color palette led by the environment's own natural tones, no artificial studio lighting rig visible anywhere, no second subject, no visible brand signage in the environment, the register of a campaign film's opening establishing frame rather than a product packshot
